title: Root organization and CSS ownership maintenance

sourceRefs.summary: Run-contract target that explains why this generated contract exists.
User approved the maintenance proposal and extended autonomous continuation on November 8.

allowedWork: The approved proposal: root configuration families and complete active consumers; existing helpers; full CSS inventory; bounded non-editor algebra style conversion; focused guards, preservation and evidence. Six-hour ceiling with 45-minute verification reserve.
disallowedWork: Editor interface or checkout edits; new visual treatments or semantics; changing reader URLs; dependency upgrades; services; publication; merges; branch cleanup; unrelated refactors.
goal: Reduce root configuration clutter and cross-example style coupling while preserving complete consumers and existing behavior.
